set.body:
Outcome

Represent relational partition pairing independently of train/test validation.

Acceptance

- Ordered left/right partition keys, edge weights, reducer, generalization axis, and independence claim participate in plan identity.
- Reversal is explicit and lawfully transposes results.
- All-pairs, cross-run, forward-only, and rectangular designs cannot be confused with leave-one-out training folds.
- Invalid or unsupported independence claims fail closed.
set.title: P3.4: implement ordered PairingDesign with generalization and independence claims
